description:
Get your own Sequenzy account information (not your customers' B2B accounts; use list_accounts for those) including available companies, the current API key's permission scopes, and the API Keys management URL. Useful after a missing-scope error to inspect access and find the replacement-key settings. When the key has access to multiple companies, other tools need a target company: either one selected with select_company or a companyId passed in each call.

The response shows 'companies' (all available) and 'selectedCompanyId' (currently active). Subsequent operations use the selected company unless a companyId override is passed.
name: get_account

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_account` MCP tool.

account.description: The account record returned by Sequenzy.

apiKeyPermissions.description: Current API key preset and scopes, whether common marketing work is discoverable, any missing marketing read scopes, `canSendLive` plus `missingLiveDeliveryScopes` (delivery this key cannot perform, e.g. `transactional:send` for `send_email`; check before composing anything meant to be sent) `liveDeliveryBlockedByRole` (a viewer role blocks sending no matter the scopes, so widening the key will not help), `roleRestrictedScopes` (scopes the workspace role cannot use through a personal key - a marketer lists `transactional:send` here while still able to send campaigns), and the API Keys management URL.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

companies.description: List of company records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.

currentCompanyId.description: Company ID selected by the authenticated API key, when available.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

selectedCompanyId.description: Company ID selected locally for subsequent MCP calls, when available.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
